title: 分页 KV
note_on_kind: 标准代码章（非 primer）：走 implementer 精简版 + lint_fidelity 全链。Part IV 开章（显存是主角）——ch9 立了心跳骨架、ch10 打开①拍 token 账本、ch11 讲了抢占与请求一生、ch12 讲了默认重叠心跳；调度器全程只借还 block_id、不知道块里怎么放——本章把这个 block_id 的世界整个打开：L0 的 KV 账本列（Scheduler/KVCacheManager/BlockPool）中后两块。叙事角度按 pedagogy-plan：「利用率 20-38%→满」——先立每 token KV 显存公式与三源浪费（论文 20.4%-38.2%），再讲虚拟内存类比的落地代码。
hook_suggestion: 「同一条 prompt 复用一段 KV 能省一半算力，可旧系统 80% 的 KV 显存买来就躺在那儿浪费——20.4%-38.2% 的利用率是被哪三样浪费吃掉的？vLLM 把整块 KV 显存切成 16 token 一页的块池、给每个请求发一张逻辑块表，凭什么敢像操作系统管内存一样按需拿页、把利用率顶到满？调度器进程里的 Python 账本和 GPU 上的物理槽位隔着一条进程边界，凭什么只靠一个 block_id 就能对上账？」（从 Part IV hook『显存就那么多，KV cache 必须活到最后』+ 本章主题『分页 KV』+ deepread/memory-kv.json why_chains[0]（三源浪费/虚拟内存类比）与 contracts[1]（block_id 唯一共享键）提炼）
scope_note: 主线 = 单组全注意力主路径的分页机制（Part IV 开章）：(A) 为什么分页——每 token KV 显存公式、旧连续预分配的三源浪费（论文实测利用率 20.4%-38.2%）→ 虚拟内存类比（blocks=pages / tokens=bytes / requests=processes）；(B) 调度器侧纯 CPU 元数据账本：BlockPool（KVCacheBlock slots 七字段 + 侵入式自由队列 + null_block）、FullAttentionManager.req_to_blocks 逻辑块表、get_num_blocks_to_allocate 需块预测（cdiv 算术）、allocate_slots 三段式（容量检查→挂命中块→分新块→写回）、引用计数生命周期（+1/−1/归零入队）与终局逆序 free；(C) block_id 跨进程契约：SchedulerOutput 全量块表/增量 new_block_ids/新块清零账 → worker 侧 CachedRequestState.block_ids + input_batch.block_table（CpuGpuBuffer 双镜像页表）+ KVBlockZeroer Triton 清零；(D) GPU 寻址与物理布局：compute_slot_mapping Triton kernel 的槽位恒等式 slot = 块号×block_size + pos%block_size、每层 说明性视图 [num_blocks, 2, block_size, kv_heads, head_dim]（真实形状由注意力后端仲裁） 张量视图（real_page_size_bytes 公式）、attention 写走 slot_mapping/读走 block_table。边界与邻章分工：池多大/profile 三步定账/水位/full-ISL 准入门/混合注意力组化（多组块表、null_block 换位、kernel 块细分）归 ch14 显存账本；链式哈希/前缀命中/LRU 驱逐不变量/CoW/Marconi 归 ch15 前缀缓存；KVConnector/P-D 归 ch16；Triton kernel 的 CP 交错/PAD 语义/DCP 与 D2H 禁忌深挖归 ch22；attention 后端如何消费块表归 ch21——本章把 block_table 间接寻址埋为 F7 伏笔。前缀缓存在本章只作为 allocate_slots 的两个黑盒参数（new_computed_blocks 命中块 / cache_blocks 写回）出现。

stations.what: 启动·池的构造：BlockPool(num_gpu_blocks)——KVCacheBlock 对象数组一次预构、侵入式自由队列整串串起、null_block 从队头 popleft 占掉 block_id=0（ref_cnt 不维护、处处特判；占位语义 → ch14）。池多大、显存怎么 profile 出来 → ch14 显存账本
入场要块：WAITING 侧 allocate_slots——ch10 第 10 站的黑盒入口本章打开。前缀命中块作为 new_computed_blocks 参数一并传入（命中怎么查 → ch15）；拿不到块返回 None，ch10 只见 break，本章看到 None 的出生地
数块：get_num_blocks_to_allocate——主算术 cdiv(num_tokens, block_size)；running 走 fast-path 差值（L194-L200）；「可驱逐的命中块也占容量」要数进去（L223-L225）。预测值+水位 > 空闲 → 上层 return None = ch11 抢占信号的内因

拿块挂账：allocate_new_blocks → block_pool.get_new_blocks（L647-L677）：free_block_queue.popleft_n 取最旧空闲块、ref_cnt=1；新块 append 进 req_to_blocks[req]（L359-L366）= 请求的逻辑块表加长一段；新块 id 顺手记进 self.new_block_ids（L367-L368）
过线打包：新请求带全量块表 NewRequestData.from_request(req, blocks.get_block_ids())；已在跑的请求只带增量 new_block_ids（L1451-L1453 get_block_ids(allow_none=True)，空则 None 不占带宽）——block_id 是调度器进程与 worker 进程之间唯一共享键
清零账：_get_new_block_ids_to_zero——take_new_block_ids 每步排干（注释 "does not grow unbounded"）→ new_block_ids_to_zero 随 SchedulerOutput 过线（async KV load 覆写区跳过集合 → ch16）
worker 镜像：_update_states——在跑请求逐组 block_ids.extend(new_ids)（L1445-L1446）、被抢占恢复的整表替换（L1447-L1452）→ input_batch.block_table.append_row 把块 id 写进 CPU 侧页表行（L1473-L1474；CpuGpuBuffer 双镜像，ch18 深讲）
清零新块：KVBlockZeroer 的 Triton kernel 清零刚到手的块——注释原话 "to prevent stale NaN/data from corrupting attention or SSM computation"。块是从自由队列回收的，上一任主人留下的字节还躺在显存里（CoW 拷贝旁路 L1223-L1228 → ch15）

槽位换算：compute_slot_mapping（L182-L211）派发 _compute_slot_mapping_kernel——块号 = block_table[req][pos // block_size]、槽位 = 块号 × block_size + pos % block_size（L434-L440 恒等式本体）。本拍 positions 本身是 GPU 张量（gpu_model_runner.py:L2188-L2191），换算全程不落 CPU（CP 分片/PAD → ch22）

前向读写：注意力 kernel 写 KV 走 slot_mapping（每 token 一个物理槽位）、读历史 KV 走块表张量（_get_block_table 把 get_device_tensor 交给 attention metadata builder）——写是直寻址、读是间接寻址。F7 伏笔埋点：这套间接寻址的代价与 kernel 内景 → ch22（数学 → ch20、后端选择 → ch21）
长大：RUNNING 循环 allocate_slots——decode 每多生成 block_size 个 token 就多要一块（fast-path max(需−有, 0)）；池满 None → while True 抢占环（外部行为 ch11：free 全部块、num_computed_tokens=0、回 waiting 队头）

终局还块：_free_blocks → kv_cache_manager.free（L567-L578）→ 逆序 free_blocks（single_type L519-L527，docstring 原话 "tail blocks are freed first"）——每块 ref_cnt−1，归零且非 null 的回自由队列尾（哈希保留在表 → ch15 前缀复用的物质基础）；async 调度下先扣在 deferred_frees 等在途步栅栏（L2341-L2354）

stations_note: 站号 = 一个请求的 KV 一生的代码顺序：第 1 站是启动期一次性的池构造（先有池、后有请求）；第 2-4 站是入场要块（waiting 侧 allocate_slots 黑盒打开：数块 → 拿块 → 挂账）；第 5-6 站是过线前打包（全量/增量块表 + 清零账）；第 7-8 站是 worker 进程镜像（追加行 + 清零新块）；第 9-10 站是 GPU 寻址与读写（槽位恒等式 → attention 写 slot_mapping/读 block_table）；第 11 站是 decode 稳态长大（每 block_size 个 token 多要一块，拿不到即 ch11 的抢占信号）；第 12 站是终局还块（逆序 free、ref_cnt 归零回池）。正文按讲解需要编排——建议先立「账本三件套」（池/块/队列）再讲过线契约，最后收在槽位恒等式；worker 侧块表张量的物理布局可按需提前。

key_classes.name: KVCacheBlock
key_classes.responsibility: 分页最小单元的元数据：@dataclass(slots=True) 七字段——block_id（物理块号）、ref_cnt（引用计数）、_block_hash/_block_hash_num_tokens（ch15 缓存账位）、prev/next_free_block（自由队列侵入式指针，只许 FreeKVCacheBlockQueue 碰）、is_null（占位块标记）。

key_classes.name: FreeKVCacheBlockQueue
key_classes.responsibility: 空闲块的自实现双向链表（fake head/tail 哨兵）：队头=最旧空闲块（popleft/popleft_n 取块）、队尾=最近归还（append/append_n/prepend_n）；O(1) remove 供 touch 从中间摘块（ch15）；操纵块上指针、不分配 Python 对象。

key_classes.name: BlockPool
key_classes.responsibility: 全局块管家：blocks 数组、free_block_queue、null_block；原语 get_new_blocks（取块+ref_cnt+1+惰性摘哈希）/ touch（+1 出队）/ free_blocks（-1 归零入队）；get_num_free_blocks/get_usage 供容量检查与观测（哈希索引 cached_block_hash_to_block 部分 → ch15）。

key_classes.name: SingleTypeKVCacheManager / FullAttentionManager
key_classes.responsibility: 每注意力类型一份块账本：req_to_blocks（请求→块序列，即逻辑块表）、num_cached_block；get_num_blocks_to_allocate 需块预测、allocate_new_blocks 拿块挂账、cache_blocks 写回满块（→ ch15）、free/pop_blocks_for_free 终局摘账、take_new_block_ids 供清零。

key_classes.name: KVCacheManager / KVCacheBlocks
key_classes.responsibility: 对 Scheduler 的门面（KVCacheBlocks 包装专门隐藏内部结构，docstring 原话 "to hide KVCacheManager's internal data structure from the Scheduler"）：allocate_slots 三段式（容量检查→挂命中块→分新块→写回）、free、take_new_block_ids；watermark（→ ch14）也住在这。

key_classes.name: BlockTable / MultiGroupBlockTable
key_classes.responsibility: worker 侧页表镜像：block_table（[max_num_reqs, max_blocks_per_req] int32 的 CpuGpuBuffer，CPU 写行/commit 拷 GPU）+ slot_mapping（[max_num_batched_tokens] int64）；append_row 差量追加、compute_slot_mapping 派发 Triton kernel（恒等式本体）；MultiGroupBlockTable 多组各一张（→ ch14）。

key_classes.name: KVBlockZeroer
key_classes.responsibility: 新块清零器：构造期预计算各段绝对地址表，每步 zero_block_ids 用 Triton kernel 把新分块的显存清零——块是从自由队列回收的，不清就是上一任主人的陈旧数据。

key_classes.name: AttentionSpec
key_classes.responsibility: 页的物理形状载体：num_kv_heads/head_size/dtype + real_page_size_bytes = 2×block_size×num_kv_heads×head_dim×dtype 字节（page_size_bytes 再叠量化 padding）——「一块多大」的唯一公式。

why_chains.decision: 分页 KV：固定大小 block 池 + 每请求一张逻辑块表（PagedAttention 的虚拟内存类比）
why_chains.old_design: vLLM 之前的服务系统（FasterTransformer/Orca）按请求最大长度一次性预分配连续显存。vLLM 论文原话「they pre-allocate a contiguous chunk of memory with the request's maximum length (e.g., 2048 tokens)」（arXiv:2309.06180 §2.2）。浪费三源：内部碎片（实际输出远短于 max_len）、外部碎片（要求连续，释放留洞）、冗余复制（beam/parallel sampling 的共享前缀各存一份）。
why_chains.pain: 有效 KV 显存利用率被卡死：论文实测「only 20.4% - 38.2% of the KV cache memory is used to store the actual token states in the existing systems」（§5.2，Alpaca/ShareGPT 真实 trace；注意是 38.2 不是流传的 38.3）。显存浪费直接压 batch size → 吞吐被卡；论文报告分页后同延迟下吞吐 2-4×。
why_chains.solution: 整块 KV 显存切成 num_gpu_blocks 个等大 block 的池（vllm/v1/core/block_pool.py:L175-L181，blocks 数组一次预构）；每个请求每组建一张逻辑块表 req_to_blocks（vllm/v1/core/single_type_kv_cache_manager.py:L97）；物理槽位由 token 位置在 GPU 上换算：slot = block_table[req][pos // block_size] * block_size + pos % block_size（vllm/v1/worker/block_table.py:L430-L440 Triton kernel _compute_slot_mapping_kernel）。块按需分配，单请求浪费 < 1 个 block。论文类比原话「blocks as pages, tokens as bytes, requests as processes」。
why_chains.cost: ① 注意力 kernel 必须穿过块表间接寻址（PagedAttention/FlashAttention 变体），比连续读复杂；② 尾部最多浪费 block_size-1 个 token 位（默认 block_size=16，vllm/config/cache.py:L47 DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE）；③ 调度器与 GPU 各持一份真相，block_id 是唯一共享键，两侧必须严格同步（见契约）。
why_chains.note: 本章第一主角（分页总布局与三源浪费）。其中「PagedAttention/FlashAttention 变体 kernel 穿块表」的 cost ① 即 F7 伏笔，ch22 回收；链中 slot 换算引用 block_table.py:L430-L440 已按 v0.27.1 复核为 L434-L440。

@dataclass(slots=True)
class KVCacheBlock:
    """KV-cache block metadata."""

    # Block ID, ranging from 0 to num_gpu_blocks - 1.
    block_id: int
    # Reference count.
    ref_cnt: int = 0
    # The hash key (block hash + group id) of the block, only available
    # when the block is full and cached.
    _block_hash: BlockHashWithGroupId | None = None
    # Number of prefix tokens covered by _block_hash. For full blocks this is
    # the full block boundary; partial entries can end inside a cache block.
    _block_hash_num_tokens: int | None = None

    # Used to construct a doubly linked list for free blocks.
    # These two attributes should only be manipulated by FreeKVCacheBlockQueue.
    prev_free_block: "KVCacheBlock | None" = None
    next_free_block: "KVCacheBlock | None" = None

    # Whether the block is a null block that should never be cached.
    is_null: bool = False

class FreeKVCacheBlockQueue:
    """This class organizes a list of KVCacheBlock objects to a doubly linked
    list of free blocks. We implement this class instead of using Python
    builtin deque to support removing a block in the middle of the queue
    in O(1) time. To close the performance gap to the builtin deque which is
    implemented in C++, this class does not allocate any Python objects when
    manipulating the linked list. Instead, this class manipulates the
    prev_free_block and next_free_block attributes of the given blocks.

    The queue is ordered by block ID in the beginning. When a block is allocated
    and then freed, it will be appended back with the eviction order:
    1. The least recent used block is at the front (LRU).
    2. If two blocks have the same last accessed time (allocated by the
       same sequence), the one with more hash tokens (the tail of a block
       chain) is at the front.
    Note that we maintain this order by reversing the block order when free
    blocks of a request. This operation is outside of this class.

    Args:
        blocks: A list of KVCacheBlock objects.
    """

    def __init__(self, blocks: list[KVCacheBlock]) -> None:
        self.num_free_blocks = len(blocks)

        # Initialize doubly links of consecutive blocks
        for i in range(self.num_free_blocks):
            if i > 0:
                blocks[i].prev_free_block = blocks[i - 1]
            if i < self.num_free_blocks - 1:
                blocks[i].next_free_block = blocks[i + 1]

        # Create a fake head and a tail block for the doubly linked list to
        # reduce branching in the code
        #
        # The implementation guaranteed that the fake head and tail
        # are NEVER got popped, so we could safely assume each real blocks
        # in the queue has prev and next blocks.
        self.fake_free_list_head = KVCacheBlock(block_id=-1)
        self.fake_free_list_tail = KVCacheBlock(block_id=-1)
        if self.num_free_blocks > 0:
            # Connect fake_head and fake_tail to the first and last block
            # respectively.
            self.fake_free_list_head.next_free_block = blocks[0]
            blocks[0].prev_free_block = self.fake_free_list_head
            self.fake_free_list_tail.prev_free_block = blocks[-1]
            blocks[-1].next_free_block = self.fake_free_list_tail
        else:
            # For empty list, simply connect the fake head and tail.
            self.fake_free_list_head.next_free_block = self.fake_free_list_tail
            self.fake_free_list_tail.prev_free_block = self.fake_free_list_head

def popleft_n(self, n: int) -> list[KVCacheBlock]:
        """Pop the first n free blocks and reduce num_free_blocks by n.

        Args:
            n: The number of blocks to pop.

        Returns:
            A list of n free blocks.
        """
        if n == 0:
            return []
        assert self.num_free_blocks >= n
        self.num_free_blocks -= n

        curr_block = self.fake_free_list_head.next_free_block
        # Pop n blocks from the head of the list
        ret = []
        for _ in range(n):
            assert curr_block is not None
            ret.append(curr_block)
            last_block = curr_block
            curr_block = curr_block.next_free_block
            # Reset prev_free_block and next_free_block of all popped blocks
            last_block.prev_free_block = None
            last_block.next_free_block = None

        if curr_block is not None:
            # The queue is not empty, connect the fake head to
            # the new first block.
            self.fake_free_list_head.next_free_block = curr_block
            curr_block.prev_free_block = self.fake_free_list_head
        return ret

def touch(self, blocks: Sequence[KVCacheBlock]) -> None:
        """Touch a block increases its reference count by 1, and may remove
        the block from the free queue. This is used when a block is hit by
        another request with the same prefix.

        Args:
            blocks: A list of blocks to touch.
        """
        for block in blocks:
            # ref_cnt=0 means this block is in the free list (i.e. eviction
            # candidate), so remove it.
            if block.ref_cnt == 0 and not block.is_null:
                self.free_block_queue.remove(block)
            block.ref_cnt += 1
            if self.metrics_collector:
                self.metrics_collector.on_block_accessed(block)

    def free_blocks(self, ordered_blocks: Iterable[KVCacheBlock]) -> None:
        """Free a list of blocks. The blocks should be ordered by their
        eviction priority, where the first block will be evicted first.

        Args:
            ordered_blocks: A list of blocks to free ordered by their eviction
                priority.
        """
        # Identify blocks with hash (LRU cache) and without it (never match APC)
        blocks_with_hash = []
        blocks_without_hash = []
        for block in ordered_blocks:
            block.ref_cnt -= 1
            if block.ref_cnt == 0 and not block.is_null:
                # When caching is disabled we always append for better
                # GPU cache locality from reusing recently used blocks
                if block.block_hash is None and self.enable_caching:
                    blocks_without_hash.append(block)
                else:
                    blocks_with_hash.append(block)

        # Blocks without hash get evicted first - prepend them last to the tail
        self.free_block_queue.prepend_n(blocks_without_hash)
        self.free_block_queue.append_n(blocks_with_hash)

            # num_required_blocks may be smaller than num_req_blocks.
            return max(num_required_blocks - num_req_blocks, 0)

        num_local_computed_blocks = len(new_computed_blocks) + num_req_blocks
        # Number of whole blocks that are skipped by the attention window.

        # We need blocks for the non-skipped suffix. If there are still
        # local-computed blocks inside the window, they contribute to the
        # required capacity; otherwise, skipped blocks dominate.
        num_new_blocks = max(
            num_required_blocks - max(num_skipped_blocks, num_local_computed_blocks),

        # of blocks are skipped; `num_req_blocks` of those may already be in
        # `req_to_blocks`, so only skip the remainder from `new_computed_blocks`.
        num_skipped_new_computed_blocks = max(0, num_skipped_blocks - num_req_blocks)

        # ref_cnt == 0), it will be removed from the free queue when touched by
        # the allocated request, so we must count it in the free-capacity check.
        num_evictable_blocks = self._get_num_evictable_blocks(
            new_computed_blocks[num_skipped_new_computed_blocks:]

def allocate_new_blocks(
        self, request_id: str, num_tokens: int, num_tokens_main_model: int
    ) -> list[KVCacheBlock]:
        """
        Allocate new blocks for the request to give it at least `num_tokens`
        token slots.

        Args:
            request_id: The request ID.
            num_tokens: The total number of tokens that need a slot (including
                tokens that are already allocated).
            num_tokens_main_model: The number of tokens for the main model (aka target
                model in spec decode). w/o spec decode, it is num_tokens;
                with spec decode, it is num_tokens - num_lookahead_tokens.
        Returns:
            The new allocated blocks.
        """
        cow_blocks: list[KVCacheBlock] = []
        if request_id in self._partial_hit_reqs:
            # Partial hit: redirect the shared tail to a private CoW block.
            # Replacing in place keeps the length-based allocation below
            # correct; the extra block was reserved by
            # get_num_blocks_to_allocate.
            block_idx, source_block = self._partial_hit_reqs.pop(request_id)
            cow_block = self.block_pool.get_new_blocks(1)[0]
            self._apply_cow(request_id, block_idx, source_block, cow_block)
            self.new_block_ids.append(cow_block.block_id)
            cow_blocks.append(cow_block)

        req_blocks = self.req_to_blocks[request_id]
        num_required_blocks = cdiv(num_tokens, self.block_size)
        num_new_blocks = num_required_blocks - len(req_blocks)
        if num_new_blocks <= 0:
            return cow_blocks
        else:
            new_blocks = self.block_pool.get_new_blocks(num_new_blocks)
            req_blocks.extend(new_blocks)
            if self._record_new_block_ids:
                self.new_block_ids.extend(b.block_id for b in new_blocks)
            return cow_blocks + new_blocks

def _get_new_block_ids_to_zero(self) -> list[int] | None:
        # Drain new attention block ids every step so the manager-side list
        # does not grow unbounded; only kv-cache zeroing consumes them.

theory.topic: 每 token KV 显存公式（Part IV 开场立「显存是主角」）
theory.detail: 自回归注意力每个新 token 都要读全部历史 token 的 K/V——KV cache 每 token 字节数 = 2(K,V) × num_layers × num_kv_heads × head_dim × dtype_bytes。Llama-2-7B FP16：2×32×32×128×2 = 524,288 B ≈ 0.5 MB/token（deepread/memory-kv.json why_chains[1] 口径的计算例，非源码断断言）；一条 4096-token 序列的 KV 就要 ~2 GB。权重之外的全部显存都是 KV 的粮仓——Part IV hook「显存就那么多，KV cache 必须活到最后」。

theory.topic: 旧设计三源浪费与利用率 20.4%-38.2%（论文口径）
theory.detail: vLLM 之前的服务系统按请求最大长度一次性预分配连续显存（arXiv:2309.06180 §2.2 原话 "pre-allocate a contiguous chunk of memory with the request's maximum length"）。浪费三源：内部碎片（实际输出远短于 max_len，预留即浪费）、外部碎片（要求连续，释放留洞）、冗余复制（beam/parallel sampling 共享前缀各存一份）。论文实测（§5.2，注意是 38.2 不是流传的 38.3）："only 20.4% - 38.2% of the KV cache memory is used to store the actual token states in the existing systems"；分页后同延迟吞吐 2-4×。

theory.topic: 页的物理形状：real_page_size_bytes 公式与 说明性视图 [num_blocks, 2, block_size, kv_heads, head_dim]（真实形状由注意力后端仲裁） 视图
theory.detail: 每层一块张量，一块页装 block_size 个 token 的 K 与 V：real_page_size_bytes = 2 × block_size × num_kv_heads × head_dim × dtype 字节（vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py:L220-L226）。worker 侧 num_blocks = 原始字节数 // page_size_bytes（gpu_model_runner.py:L7406-L7407），调度器侧 num_blocks 由启动期账本定（→ ch14）——两侧必须同源同值（单一事实源 = KVCacheConfig）。

theory.topic: 块数换算与槽位恒等式（worked example 的算术底座）
theory.detail: 块数 = cdiv(num_tokens, block_size)（get_num_blocks_to_allocate L178）；槽位 = block_table[req][pos // block_size] × block_size + pos % block_size（Triton kernel L434-L440）。例：block_size=16、prompt 100 token → 7 块（112 个槽），第 100 个 token（pos=99）落在第 6 块（99//16=6）的第 3 槽（99%16=3），物理槽位 = 块表第 6 项的块号 × 16 + 3。逆运算：给定 slot，block_number = slot // block_size、块内偏移 = slot % block_size——写侧（slot_mapping）与读侧（块表）共用同一恒等式。

theory.topic: 尾部浪费上界：分页后每请求浪费 < 1 块
theory.detail: 分页下单请求最多浪费 block_size−1 个 token 位（不满的尾块），对比旧连续分配的浪费 = max_len − 实际长度（可差数量级）+ 外部碎片 + 共享前缀重复。代价：① 注意力 kernel 必须穿块表间接寻址（F7 → ch22）；② block_size 越大尾部浪费上界越大、但每请求簿记越省——DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE=16（vllm/config/cache.py:L47）是默认折中；③ 调度器与 GPU 各持一份真相，block_id 是唯一共享键，两侧必须严格同步（本章第 5-8 站）。

theory.topic: 复杂度账（v1 的 CPU 战场）
theory.detail: popleft_n O(n) 取 n 块；free_blocks O(n)；每步每请求 O(块数) Python 循环仍在高并发下付税——v1 的对策是 slots dataclass + 侵入式链表（操纵块上指针、零对象分配）+ 预构空 KVCacheBlocks（kv_cache_manager.py:L180-L187）压 GC（WC2）。侵入式链表牺牲 deque 的 C 实现，换 O(1) 中间删除（touch 救回，ch15）与零分配——「用数据结构的纪律换调度循环的毫秒」。

A1_fast_path_gate.question: 进不进 fast-path 的准确开关是什么？是 request 状态？is_prefill？调度相位？
A1_fast_path_gate.answer_one_line: 都不是——开关是 `request_id in self.num_cached_block`：一个「该请求已有满块写回过缓存」的记账位（dict 键），由挂账/写回两处写入、请求退场时删除。

facts.claim: 判定本身是 dict 成员测试，不是状态位
facts.evidence: vllm/v1/core/single_type_kv_cache_manager.py:L194-L200（`if request_id in self.num_cached_block:` → 断言空命中 → `return max(num_required_blocks - num_req_blocks, 0)`）
facts.intuition: num_cached_block 是「该请求已缓存到第几块」的增量游标（值=len 已写回满块），兼职 fast-path 开关：只要它存在，就说明这个请求已经过了首排、块表已在增长，账简化成『目标表长 − 已持表长』。

facts.evidence: ① 挂账时：vllm/v1/core/single_type_kv_cache_manager.py:L282（`self.num_cached_block[request_id] = len(req_blocks)`，首排带命中/外部 token 时挂账即武装）；② 同函数 partial 命中下修：L289（`self.num_cached_block[request_id] = block_idx`，只算整块）；③ 写回满块：L477（`self.num_cached_block[request.request_id] = num_full_blocks`，num_full_blocks = num_tokens_to_cache // block_size，L446）
facts.intuition: 三处都是『≥1 个整块落袋』的时刻——partial 命中那处反着读更清楚：账位被钉在整块边界 block_idx 上，块内那半截不算『已缓存』。

facts.claim: 反直觉边界一：短请求（prompt+已生成 < block_size）一直不武装、恒走慢路径
facts.evidence: cache_blocks 幂等闸早退：vllm/v1/core/single_type_kv_cache_manager.py:L445-L448（`num_cached_blocks >= num_full_blocks: return`，prompt=5、block_size=16 时 num_full_blocks=0、0>=0 成立）
facts.intuition: 数字例（block_size=16，开缓存，prompt=5）：第 1~11 个 decode 拍请求总长 5..15 <16，num_full_blocks 恒 0，账位始终不存在；第 12 拍（总长 16）写回第 1 个满块才武装。武装前后公式结果相同（见 A2 退化证明），只是路径不同——所以这条边界无正确性影响，只有『谁在走哪条路』的解说价值。

facts.claim: 反直觉边界二：关缓存（--no-enable-prefix-caching）时永不武装
facts.evidence: vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_manager.py:L551-L552（`if not self.enable_caching or delay_cache_blocks: return`，写回整段被跳过）→ cache_blocks 的 L477 永不执行；挂账路径 L529-L531 只在有命中/外部 token 时进，而关缓存时命中恒空
facts.intuition: 这正是 ch13 精简版「关缓存恒走慢路径」的机制根源（正文 L534 那个括注可以据此扩写成一小段）。

facts.claim: 断言『running 请求无新命中』的真正保证人在调度器，且是『每次入场』而非『一生一次』
facts.evidence: vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py:L745（`if request.num_computed_tokens == 0:` 才做 get_computed_blocks）+ L854-L859（else 拿 empty_kv_cache_blocks 过账）；第二道闸在协调器：vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_coordinator.py:L210-L217（running 请求 allocate_new_computed_blocks 直接 no-op + assert all empty）。被抢占请求重新入场时 num_computed_tokens 被清 0（vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py:L1294，_preempt_request 内）、块也全 free（L1290 → kv_cache_manager.free → pop_blocks_for_free 把 num_cached_block.pop，vllm/v1/core/single_type_kv_cache_manager.py:L515）——所以恢复首排会重新开闸查前缀（自己的旧缓存可被自己再命中，这是抢占便宜的根源之一）

A2_slow_path_formula.question: get_num_blocks_to_allocate 的完整非 fast-path 公式：三个参数各是什么、怎么算、为什么减它们？token 级已算量→块换算的桥梁是什么？
A2_slow_path_formula.answer_one_line: 返回值的准确语义是『本拍将从自由队列摘走多少块』：新分配的 + CoW 换来的 + 被 touch 摘走的可驱逐命中块；减 max(num_skipped_blocks, num_local_computed_blocks) 是因为这些位置不需要从池里拿实体块。

formula_breakdown.meaning: 目标表长：本拍结束时请求块表 req_to_blocks 应有的长度。num_tokens=num_tokens_need_slot=min(comp+new_comp+ext_comp+new+lookahead, max_model_len)（vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_manager.py:L490-L493）
已持表长：这个请求名下已经挂着的块（含滑窗跳段被换成 null 的占位——replace 不缩表，vllm/v1/core/single_type_kv_cache_manager.py:L622-L659）
注意力窗外、不再被读的 token 数。全注意力基类恒 0（L661-L672）；SWA=max(0, T-W+1)（L1083，源码自带 W=4,T=7→4 的 ASCII 例）；chunked-local=(T//chunk)*chunk（L1239-L1242）。注意基数是 total_computed_tokens（含外部 token）
已就位的实体块数：已持 + 本拍新命中的（命中天然以块为单位，1 块=block_size token——这是五段表驱动换算的出处，vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_manager.py:L418）
跳段换块用 floor 不用 cdiv：跨窗边界的块还有一角在窗内、必须保留实体，只有整块全在窗外才能换 null 占位
max(...) = 挂账（touch 命中 + null 占位）之后、无需新实体块的表长。取 max 的两种触发：无跳段时=已持+命中；跳段超过已就位时（只在 ext_comp 抬高 total_computed_tokens 的混合场景出现）以跳段为准——null 占位本身就占表长
命中块里落在跳段前缀内的那部分：不会被 touch（不会离开自由队列），所以要从可驱逐计数里剔掉
将被 touch 的命中块中 ref_cnt==0 且非 null 的（正在自由队列里当驱逐候选）——touch 会把它们从自由队列摘走，所以虽不『新分配』也占容量。漏数它容量检查就失真（注释原话 L220-L222）
partial 命中预留 CoW 私有块（见 A4）
= 本拍自由队列净减量。分配侧对账：allocate_external_computed_blocks 的 get_new_blocks + allocate_new_blocks 的 get_new_blocks + touch 摘走的可驱逐命中块，三处加起来严格等于它（预测器与分配器同构的总量口径）

three_params.what: 滑窗/块内局部注意力已滑出窗外、换成 null 占位的整块数
three_params.why_subtract: null_block 不是实体块、永不出租（构造期从队头抽出贴 is_null 封条、ref_cnt 不维护须特判防误释放，vllm/v1/core/block_pool.py:L186-L191；get_usage 分母也永远少记这一块，L807-L818）；这些表位不需要从池里拿块

three_params.what: 已持块 + 本拍新命中块（都是『已有着落』的实体块）
three_params.why_subtract: 已持的早就分配过；命中的由 touch 复用别人的，不走 get_new_blocks——但 ref_cnt==0 的命中块要单独加回 evictable

three_params.what: 命中块里正躺在自由队列（ref_cnt==0 非 null）的个数
three_params.how: sum(blk.ref_cnt == 0 and not blk.is_null for blk in 剔除跳段后的命中块)（L128-L130）
three_params.why_add: touch 会把它们从自由队列中间摘走——既是复用又占容量，必须计入容量检查；这是公式里两个加法项之一（另一个是 partial 命中的 CoW 预留 +1）

A2_slow_path_formula.bridge: token→块有三种取整、各管一摊：cdiv 管容量（目标表长）、floor 管跳段（跨界块留实体）、命中以块计数（len，天然块单位）。守恒式：目标表长 = null 占位 + 命中实体 + external 新块 + 新块；预测返回值 = 后三项里要从池里拿的（external+new+CoW）+ 被 touch 摘走的可驱逐命中块。『已算过的 token』不等于『不用分配的块』——ext_comp 就是反例：token 已算过（connector 缓存了），块却要新分配（allocate_external_computed_blocks，L309-L328：cdiv(total,bs)−len(req_blocks)）。
A2_slow_path_formula.degeneration_proof: 全注意力、无命中、无外部 token 时慢路径严格退化为 fast-path：skipped=0 → max(0, num_req)=num_req → num_new = max(required−num_req, 0)；命中空 → evictable=0；无 partial → +0。所以『关缓存恒走慢路径』与『开缓存走 fast-path』算出的数永远一致——这也是短请求不武装（A1）无正确性影响的原因。

def _apply_cow(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        block_idx: int,
        source_block: KVCacheBlock,
        cow_block: KVCacheBlock,
    ) -> None:
        """Redirect a partial prefix-cache hit to a private CoW block.

        Both copy endpoints stay retained until the copy has run on the worker,
        so a same-step free cannot recycle them: ``source_block`` keeps its
        hit-ref, ``cow_block`` takes an extra ref beyond the one handed to the
        request.
        """
        req_blocks = self.req_to_blocks[request_id]
        assert block_idx < len(req_blocks)
        assert req_blocks[block_idx] is source_block
        assert not source_block.is_null and source_block.ref_cnt > 0
        req_blocks[block_idx] = cow_block
        self._pending_cow_copies.append((source_block, cow_block))
        cow_block.ref_cnt += 1

def copy_kv_cache_blocks_inplace(
    kv_caches: Iterable[torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor]],
    num_blocks: int,
    kv_cache_block_copies: Sequence[KVCacheBlockCopy],
) -> None:
    if not kv_cache_block_copies:
        return

    storage_tensors: list[torch.Tensor] = []
    seen_storage: set[int] = set()
    for entry in kv_caches:
        # Mamba layers hold a list of state tensors; attention layers a single
        # tensor. Both alias the shared block-major backing storage.
        tensors = entry if isinstance(entry, (list, tuple)) else (entry,)
        for tensor in tensors:
            ptr = tensor.untyped_storage().data_ptr()
            if ptr in seen_storage:
                continue
            seen_storage.add(ptr)
            storage_tensors.append(tensor)

def get_num_skipped_tokens(self, num_computed_tokens: int) -> int:
        """
        Get the number of tokens that will be skipped for attention computation.

        For sliding window, this corresponds to the tokens that are prior to
        the current sliding window.

        Example:
        sliding_window=4, num_computed_tokens=7

        Tokens:   [ 0  1  2  3  4  5  6  7 ]
                  | ---- computed -----|
                                         ^ next token to be computed
                               |-----------| sliding window for next token
                  |--skipped---|

        The current window contains tokens 4~7. Tokens 0~3 will be skipped for
        attention computation since they are outside the sliding window.
        Thus, get_num_skipped_tokens(7) == 4.

        Args:
            num_computed_tokens: The number of tokens that have been computed.

        Returns:
            The number of tokens that will be skipped for attention computation.
        """
        return max(0, num_computed_tokens - self.sliding_window + 1)

embed_excerpts.code:
Historically, [vLLM has long supported beam search](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/6226). The
SequenceGroup encapsulated the idea of N Sequences which
all shared the same prompt kv blocks. This enabled KV cache block
sharing between requests, and copy-on-write to do branching. CPU
swapping was intended for these beam search like cases.

Later, the concept of prefix caching was introduced, which allowed KV
cache blocks to be shared implicitly. This proved to be a better
option than CPU swapping since blocks can be evicted slowly on demand
and the part of the prompt that was evicted can be recomputed.

SequenceGroup was removed in V1, although a replacement will be
required for "parallel sampling" (`n>1`).
[Beam search was moved out of the core](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/8306). There was a
lot of complex code for a very uncommon feature.

def enqueue(self, obj, timeout: float | None = None):
        """Write to message queue with optional timeout (in seconds)"""
        assert self._is_writer, "Only writers can enqueue"
        all_buffers: list[SizedBuffer] = [b""]
        total_bytes = 6  # 2 bytes for oob buffer count, 4 for main buffer size

        def oob_callback(buf: PickleBuffer) -> bool:
            raw_buf = buf.raw()
            if len(raw_buf) < 1024 * 1024:
                # In-line buffers smaller than 1MiB.
                return True
            all_buffers.append(raw_buf)
            nonlocal total_bytes
            total_bytes += len(raw_buf) + 4
            return False

        # CPU tensors are routed through `_reduce_tensor` so that their
        # bytes are emitted as out-of-band buffers instead of being
        # copied into the pickle stream by torch's default reducer.
        # Start from `copyreg.dispatch_table` to preserve globally
        # registered reducers (e.g. `re.Pattern`); the per-pickler
        # dispatch table would otherwise shadow them.
        dispatch_table = dict(copyreg.dispatch_table)
        dispatch_table[torch.Tensor] = _reduce_tensor
        with io.BytesIO() as bio:
            pickler = pickle.Pickler(
                bio,
                protocol=pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL,
                buffer_callback=oob_callback,
            )
            pickler.dispatch_table = dispatch_table
            pickler.dump(obj)
            all_buffers[0] = bio.getvalue()
        if self.n_local_reader > 0:
            if total_bytes + len(all_buffers[0]) >= self.buffer.max_chunk_bytes:
                with self.acquire_write(timeout) as buf:
                    buf[0] = 1  # overflow
                self.local_socket.send_multipart(all_buffers, copy=False)
            else:
                # Byte 0: 0
                # Bytes 1-2: Count of buffers
                # Then each buffer follows, preceded by 4 bytes containing its length:
                # [4 byte int L][L bytes of buffer content] ...
                with self.acquire_write(timeout) as buf:
                    buf[0] = 0  # not overflow
                    offset = 3
                    buf[1:offset] = to_bytes_big(len(all_buffers), 2)  # oob buf count
                    for buffer in all_buffers:
                        buf_len = len(buffer)
                        # prepend each buffer with 4 bytes containing its size.
                        buf_offset = offset + 4
                        buf[offset:buf_offset] = to_bytes_big(buf_len, 4)
                        buf[buf_offset : (offset := buf_offset + buf_len)] = buffer

            self._spin_condition.notify()

        if self.n_remote_reader > 0:
            self.remote_socket.send_multipart(all_buffers, copy=False)
